questions.q_en: If 17 April 1992 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 10 October 1993?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of days from 17 April 1992 to 17 April 1993 = 365 days

Total number of days from 17 April 1993 to 17 September 1993 = 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 = 153 days

Total number of days from 17 September 1993 to 10 October 1993 = 23 days

Total days = 365 + 153 + 23 = 541 days = 77 weeks 2 days

Hence, the day on 10 October 1993 will be Sunday.

questions.q_en:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

Question:

A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table. Each of them faces either the center of the table or outside (i.e., opposite to the center). In which direction is D facing?

Statements:

(I) B sits second to the right of F and both are facing the center. Only two people are sitting between A and E from the either side. Both A and E are facing the same direction. A is not an immediate neighbor of B.

(II) C is facing the opposite direction of B. D is sitting to the second left of C.
options_en: Statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not.
Statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not.
questions.solution_en:
Statement I alone:

Information about only 4 persons A, B, E, and F is given. No information is given about the position and direction of D.

Statement I alone is not sufficient.

Statement II alone:

C is facing the opposite direction of B. D is sitting to the second left of C. But we are not given any information about the direction of D.

Statement II alone is not sufficient.

Statements I and II together:

We cannot determine the direction in which D faces.

Hence, statements I and II together are not sufficient.
